trust_decision.summary: Which object keys caller-traced data may write to when masked strings are written back: createAnonymizer flattens keys into a dotted/bracket path string and re-parses it through the vendored lodash set(), whose only guard is a final-key '__proto__' check, so traced keys containing '.', '[', 'constructor', 'prototype' or '__proto__' choose the write target.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'incomplete __proto__ guard in internal lodash set()', so a reader goes straight to the vendored lodash guard, not to the anonymizer that builds the path string.

fix_sites.entry_point: createAnonymizer (package export 'langsmith/anonymizer', js/scripts/create-entrypoints.js:21), also reached via new Client({anonymizer}) -> processInputs/processOutputs (js/src/client.ts:897-900, js/src/client.ts:1050-1051)
fix_sites.module_kind: library public API (path producer / tree walker)

fix_sites.entry_point: createAnonymizer, any replacer form including a custom StringNodeProcessor
none public; internal vendored helper whose only importer is js/src/anonymizer/index.ts:1 (all 14 lodash files are deleted by the fix)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: No separate module. The only other route is the user-supplied StringNodeProcessor form (js/src/anonymizer/index.ts:42-44, js/src/anonymizer/index.ts:116), which returns arbitrary {value,path} nodes into the same set() call at js/src/anonymizer/index.ts:123; it is an input variant of the same sink, not a separate module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue that custom StringNodeProcessor output is trusted developer code, so its paths need no hardening, and that dotted keys being written to the wrong place is a correctness bug, not part of the pollution advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Keys that legitimately contain '.' or '[', or are named 'constructor'/'prototype'/'__proto__', must still be redacted in place. A literal 'a.b' key and a nested a.b must stay distinct (fix test at fix.diff:200-214). Array indices and the root-string case (path '') must keep working. A blocklist that skips or drops such keys leaves secrets unredacted or changes the output shape.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Baggage metadata is caller-controlled header data that is already parsed here; a maintainer adding nested-metadata support could plausibly reuse a path setter.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: hideInputs/hideOutputs already sit next to the anonymizer option; a key-path redaction convenience would be a natural feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a parent[k] write-back in the serializer driven by a reconstructed path rather than a live parent reference
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The serializer already rewrites values in place by parent/key; a path-based variant would be a plausible refactor.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a blocklist for '__proto__'/'constructor'/'prototype' to lodash baseSet/baseAssignValue. This leaves the dotted-key differential, so 'a.b' still writes into a.b and the hidden distinct-keys test fails.
